subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds up and breaks down words into onset and rime (h-en, p-en, t-in, p-in), identifying rhymes

show.line: Split a word in two! h, en. Hen. p, en. Pen. Hen and pen rhyme!

rounds.prompt: Listen. t, in. What word is it?
b, ug. Put them together. What word is it?
Listen. m, ug. Tap the word.
Pin. Break it. Say the first sound, then the rest.
Rhymes with hen, or with pin? Sort the words.

hints: The first sound, then the rest. h, en.
Words that rhyme share the same end part.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! p, in is pin. Pen has en.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's put them together. p, in. Pin!

parent_line: Can split a word into its first sound and the rest, and hear rhymes.
